description: This file contains a tutorial and implementation example demonstrating how to use the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) with LiteLLM SDK to create intelligent agents supporting multiple Large Language Model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and LiteLLM Proxy. It includes setup instructions, environment configuration, tool definition (get_weather), and examples of agent creation with different models, along with usage of LiteLLM proxy settings.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Represents an intelligent agent capable of interacting with LLM models using specified tools and instructions.

classes.name: LiteLlm
classes.description: Represents a language model wrapper supporting different models, including proxy configurations.

classes.name: InMemorySessionService
classes.description: Provides in-memory session management for agent interactions.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Handles running the agent asynchronously within a session context.

methods.name: get_weather
methods.description: Retrieves mock weather information for specified cities, used as a tool within agents.

methods.name: call_agent_async
methods.description: Helper function to send queries to an agent asynchronously and print the response.
